title: Audit 9: hook that refuses quitting, killing or restarting the running app
notes:
A PreToolUse Bash hook, installed by the app like the board guard (#262), refuses pkill/killall of Dashboard or electron, osascript quit and open -a Dashboard, and says to report that a rebuild is needed. no-running-app.mjs already covers package and make. workflow-rule-1.

From the CLAUDE.md audit, docs/workflow/claude-md-audit.md (card fad098f2). The rule stays in CLAUDE.md until card 13 deletes it.

comments.body: PR #281 ready to merge, CI green. board guard now also refuses pkill/killall of Dashboard/electron/the pane host, kill of the app's pid (via /proc), osascript quit, open -a Dashboard and cp/mv/rm/rsync over the installed build; rebuild.sh, release.sh and out/ .vite/ builds go through. Same command and doors as #262, so the install adds nothing. workflow-decision-7. Limits: reads command text only (scripts, python -c, heredoc bodies get past); no /proc on a mac, so literal-pid kills unchecked there. CLAUDE.md line left for Audit 13.
